scope: Calibration fitting-standard file exchange in existing polynomial/nonlinear dialogs, C++ implementations and optional Python editor actions

original_behavior.source: Pinned local ImageJ1.54r Calibrator.java Open/Save and TextReader.java audit; actual original TextReader executed headlessly, not private GUI methods. Open/Save exchanges measured/known standards, not a density lookup table.

implementation.import: One column replaces known only; two columns replace both; optional nonnumeric first header, blank lines and original ASCII tokenizer separators. Java-style decimal/hex/suffix parsing then Float32 storage with negative-zero preservation. Complete bounded parse/copy precedes no-throw draft swaps.
implementation.bounds: At most1MiB input,4096 finite data rows, minimum2. Nonfinite original-reader data and unequal row widths refuse before draft mutation. Existing source dtype/fit range validation remains at fitting submission.
implementation.save: Tab-separated measured/known numeric draft. Empty column remains empty; shorter nonempty column pads0. Locale-independent round-trip double spelling; existing atomic writeBytes/file-browser replacement reused.
implementation.ui: Open points/Save points in polynomial and nonlinear dialogs. Browser suspends/resumes same draft; cancel preserves values. Source/all-revision binding and draft generation guard deferred callbacks; active owner and idle host required. Save text captured before choosing a path. No pixel reads/jobs/history change until normal fit OK.
implementation.api: Existing Editor.action accepts import_intensity_points(path), export_intensity_points(path), browse_intensity_points(save=Boolean), with optional active document_id. New C++ private parser/formatter used by UI and Python host; no Python processing implementation or public native core SDK change.
compatibility_limits: Numeric JSON drafts do not reproduce Calibrator.getData lossy character stripping or Java byte-for-byte output spelling
Strict row-width validation refuses malformed partial final rows that TextReader can silently truncate without terminal newline
Full Calibrate consolidation, remembered standards/measured means, global calibration, replay/macro/downstream behavior remain open
